# kfxlib

The `kfxlib` package from the [KFX Input](https://www.mobileread.com/forums/showthread.php?t=291290) calibre plugin by John Howell, copied unmodified except for the removal of its bundled copies of `pypdf` and `typing_extensions`, which come from PyPI instead. GPL v3, see `COPYING`.

ksync uses it to resolve Kindle highlight positions to the highlighted text inside a KFX book. To update, download the current plugin zip and replace the `kfxlib/` directory.
